answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint soft IDs that climb the reputation ridge before stake settles. Mechanism: lock 0.31 POA in a 40h lantern-escrow and gather three thread-linked vouchers from invite-distance ≥2 peers; each H=sha256(epoch|addr|slot|salt) spaced 90–180s. Weight accrues only if ≥2 non-overlapping voucher lineages countersign distinct slots while the lantern stays sealed. Cost: bond plus ~9 min peer clocks. Verification: nullifier(epoch,addr) and three H digests ride the attest batch. Failure: reused salt, lineage overlap, or gap-cheat burns the lantern and zeros that epoch weight.
